name: Asolo Prosecco

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.
Always spumante, and only from the two DOCG hill areas, Conegliano Valdobbiadene and Asolo. Prosecco is made from Glera.

notes: Prosecco is aromatic and crisp, bringing to mind yellow apple, pear, white peach and apricot.
Most is meant to taste fresh, light and fairly simple, with intense primary aromas.

blurb.text: A DOCG in Treviso province for Prosecco from Glera, with up to 15% Verdiso, Bianchetta Trevigiana, Perera and Glera Lunga. It is made as spumante, labeled Superiore, as frizzante and as still wine.
